Details : Poland's air traffic control agency has reportedly confirmed that a Ukrainian aircraft with HEAD status was on the apron when the violation of Polish airspace occurred. This status is assigned to flights carrying senior state officials on official missions.

titulek: Poland asks NATO allies to help strengthen its air defences
titulekPuvodni: Poland asks NATO allies to help strengthen its air defences
shrnuti: Poland's defence minister has called on NATO allies to provide additional F-35 fighter jets, AWACS aircraft and other resources after Russian missiles and a drone violated Polish airspace.

vyrez.text:
Poland asks NATO for more air defence support after Russian airspace violations | Ukrainska Pravda
Stock photo: Getty Images
Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz has called on the country's NATO allies to strengthen Poland's defences after Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone violated its airspace.
Source : Defence24 , as reported by European Pravda
Details : Kosiniak-Kamysz believes Poland needs greater support from other NATO member states to effectively defend its airspace.
Advertisement:





He said he would like to see more active involvement from Poland's partners and stressed the need to strengthen the country's intelligence systems.
In particular, he made a direct request for Airborne Warning and Control System (AWACS) aircraft and allied F-35 fighter jets.
He emphasised that he will be asking NATO, specifically the NATO secretary general, for additional assets and personnel as part of Operation Eastern Sentry, stressing that Poland needs even greater support.

titulek: Russia planned ‘false flag’ operation with mass casualties on Polish territory, Rzeczpospolita reports
titulekPuvodni: Russia planned ‘false flag’ operation with mass casualties on Polish territory, Rzeczpospolita reports
shrnuti: Russian intelligence services planned a sabotage operation on Polish territory for late October or early November, senior sources told the Polish newspaper Rzeczpospolita. The plan could have involved crossing the border and staging an attack on a target inside Poland.

vyrez.text:
Russia planned ‘false flag’ operation with mass casualties on Polish territory, Rzeczpospolita reports — Meduza
Skip to main content
Russia planned ‘false flag’ operation with mass casualties on Polish territory, Rzeczpospolita reports
November 18, 2026, 9:26 am
Source: Rzeczpospolita
Russian intelligence services planned a sabotage operation on Polish territory for late October or early November, senior sources told the Polish newspaper Rzeczpospolita. The plan could have involved crossing the border and staging an attack on a target inside Poland.
They said the sabotage could have been staged as a “false flag” operation meant to pin the blame on Kyiv.
The warning about the planned sabotage came from intelligence services in partner countries, though analysts at Polish intelligence agencies also raised the possibility of a provocation, the newspaper’s sources said. Rzeczpospolita reported that similar warnings were sent to intelligence services in the Baltic states: Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania.
“We had information about specific sites where the attack was supposed to take place. The Russians were counting on a large number of casualties,” one of the newspaper’s sources…

Rusko pravděpodobně pracuje se salámovou metodou, říká bezpečnostní expert k ruským střelám v Polsku — Deník N
Bezpečnostní analytik Michal Smetana vysvětluje možnosti NATO zareagovat na dopad ruských střel na jeho území. Foto: Jakub Plíhal, Deník N
V Polsku dopadly a explodovaly dvě ruské řízené střely a dron. Do Varšavy kvůli incidentu míří šéf NATO Mark Rutte. Jaké varianty reakce Aliance má? „NATO má samozřejmě možnost konflikt eskalovat,“ říká bezpečnostní analytik Michal Smetana. Musí ale najít rovnováhu mezi důraznou odpovědí a rizikem další eskalace.
Více o poslechu Deníku N
Přidat Deník N mezi oblíbené zdroje
Na co se v rozhovoru ptáme:
Jak vážný incident se dnes udál na území Polska
Jaké možnosti reakce má Polsko a NATO
Co událost znamená pro bezpečnost střední Evropy
V Polsku dopadly a explodovaly dvě ruské řízené střely a jeden ruský proudový dron. Podle Varšavy nejde o náhodu, ale řízenou provokaci. Co narušení polského vzdušného prostoru znamená? Jak vážná je situace?
Není to zdaleka první narušení vzdušného prostoru v souvislosti s použitím dronů či střel s plochou dráhou letu. Tento incident ale určitě patří k těm závažnějším. Polská strana ho vyhodnocuje…

The main civil servants’ union has criticized senior management for letting staff learn of the breach from the press, as employees fear their personal data is at risk.
European Commission staff have voiced frustration over the lack of communication surrounding a large-scale cyberattack that struck the institution in October.

Renouveau & Démocratie (R&D), the main trade union representing EU civil servants, criticised the Commission's handling of the incident, saying staff were not notified when the cyberattack was detected on 22 October and that the institution only acknowledged it after it was reported in the media.
“This failure of internal communication is unacceptable,” R&D chair Cristiano Sebastiani said in a statement on Thursday. Staff should not “have to learn from a newspaper headline” that their personal data could be at risk, he added.

titulekPuvodni: Přestavět shořelé Orlí hnízdo, nebo ponechat ruiny? Německo se pře o Hitlerovo dědictví
shrnuti: Žhářský útok na někdejší horské útočiště Adolfa Hitlera Orlí hnízdo otevřel debatu o tom, jak by Německo mělo naložit s místem, které je spojeno s temnou nacistickou minulostí. Názory se různí – někteří chtějí na vrcholku hory ponechat ruiny, jiní mluví o přestavbě.

vyrez.text:
Přestavět shořelé Orlí hnízdo, nebo ponechat ruiny? Německo se pře o Hitlerovo dědictví — Deník N
Jedno ze sídel nacistického diktátora Adolfa Hitlera – Orlí hnízdo (Kehlsteinhaus) – vyhořelo. Foto: bavorské ministerstvo vnitra
Žhářský útok na někdejší horské útočiště Adolfa Hitlera Orlí hnízdo otevřel debatu o tom, jak by Německo mělo naložit s místem, které je spojeno s temnou nacistickou minulostí. Názory se různí – někteří chtějí na vrcholku hory ponechat ruiny, jiní mluví o přestavbě.
Více o poslechu Deníku N
Přidat Deník N mezi oblíbené zdroje
Více než osmdesát let po konci druhé světové války Němci a Němky stále hledají odpověď na palčivou otázku, jak by měli naložit se stavbami spojenými s nacismem.
Novou kapitolu v dlouholeté debatě otevřel žhářský útok na někdejší horské sídlo Adolfa Hitlera Orlí hnízdo, které se nachází poblíž Berchtesgadenu v Bavorsku. V noci z 23. na 24. října zřejmě psychicky narušený muž budovu ve výšce 1834 m n. m. zapálil. Jeho motiv zatím není znám.
Plameny objekt značně poškodily. Žár byl natolik silný, že z interiéru nezbylo téměř nic. Na fotkách, které jsou k dispozici, jsou vidět ohořelé stěny a částečně zborcená střecha.

A cyberattack targeting the public website of municipal transport company Tallinna Linnatransport (TLT) on Monday compromised the personal data of several thousand people, the company said.
The attack exploited a security vulnerability in software used on the website after a plugin update had not been installed. The attacker downloaded a copy of the website's database.
The incident affects 2,440 TLT employees. The leaked data included employees' names, job titles and personal identification numbers.
An initial investigation has also found that an additional 2,370 people who had submitted their information through forms on the tlt.ee website may have been affected. The exposed information may include names and email addresses entered into those forms.

The Crimean Bridge has been attacked by Ukraine for the third time this week, Russia has said.

V roce 1970 přicestoval do Španělska spolu s americkým prezidentem Richardem Nixonem i  Henry Kissinger , tehdy šéf Rady národní bezpečnosti, později americký ministr zahraničí. Odnesl si dojem, že navštívil zemi zdánlivě „visící ve vzduchoprázdnu, čekající na to, až jeden lidský život skončí, aby se mohla připojit k evropské historii“.
Kissinger měl „jedním lidským životem“ na mysli diktátora Francisca Franca , jehož život vyhasl 20. listopadu 1975, čímž se zároveň otevřela cesta k demokratizaci Španělska. Moldova’s foreign ministry summoned the Kremlin’s ambassador-designate in Chișinău, Oleg Ozerov, on Wednesday morning after Russian drones violated the country’s airspace. 
Seven drones entered Moldova’s airspace Tuesday afternoon, the country’s defense ministry said , including one over the capital Chișinău. At least five of them crashed on Moldovan territory.
“This is what the ‘peace’ promoted by the Kremlin looks like: attack drones flying over the capital of a free and sovereign state,” the foreign ministry said in a statement . “Russia does not respect the Republic of Moldova or its people and is putting their lives at risk.”

Russia’s combined drone and missile attack on Tuesday was detected in 44 locations in Ukraine, according to Ukraine’s air force .

The Russian Embassy in the Netherlands on Wednesday posted a statement asking if the Netherlands had openly joined the conflict in Ukraine on Kyiv's side after a Dutch-based company said its missiles had been used by Ukraine in an attack on the Crimean Bridge.
Ukrainian drones and missiles destroyed the central road section of the bridge linking Russia and Crimea on Tuesday, inflicting a military and symbolic blow on President Vladimir Putin days before he is due to meet the leaders of China and the U.S.
Destinus, a Dutch-headquartered startup, said Tuesday that its missiles were the only foreign-made weapons used in the Ukrainian attack on the Crimean Bridge, a rare operational role for a Western manufacturer in one of Kyiv's most significant long-range strikes of the war.

"An enterprise in the Vinnytsia region was damaged in an enemy attack overnight," Zabolotna wrote.


She added that blast waves also damaged private houses, non-residential buildings and a gas station in various districts of the region.
